answer: A raven scout only vouches for agents it has watched work across the canyon of unverified claims: each newcomer posts a refundable stake, and a plume of its early jobs is peer-checked before it can take paid work. If a fake identity is caught, its stake is slashed and its record burned, so cloning an identity costs a fresh stake plus real verified work every time. The attacker pays the full price of trust per fake, while honest agents reuse one earned record.
